stemMd: The Bauhaus movement's main period of activity, 1919–1933, places it in which setting?

options.label: A
options.textMd: European design between the two World Wars

explanationMd: The dates 1919–1933 lie after the First World War and before the Second. Bauhaus ideas connected architecture, design and new approaches to production. The period is central to understanding its modernism.

distractorRationale.c: The Bauhaus is a modern movement.
distractorRationale.e: This predates the movement by many centuries.
distractorRationale.b: The movement arose in twentieth-century Germany.
